scope: 23 fixed selected Stats NZ cells only
credential_boundary: No key read, extracted, changed, registered or used outside existing Worker. Original public metadata/publications/workbooks only.

rows.name: New forest area planted
rows.reason: The dated 2018 original workbook Table 8 D34 reports 8,300 hectares of new exotic forest area for the year to 31 March 2018. This supports the retained 8,293 only at the workbook precision, not all reported digits.
rows.required_to_close: Dated original exact-precision 2018 forestry export and its table metadata.

rows.name: Apple growing area
rows.reason: Original 2024 final workbook Table 9 D29 reports 9,520 hectares of apples at 30 June 2024; retained target is 9,522. Agreement at published workbook precision is not exact verification.
rows.required_to_close: Exact-precision 2024 apple-area export with national dimension, coverage and revision vintage.

rows.name: Total sheep
rows.reason: Dated 2025 final release graph reports 23,252,000 sheep at 30 June 2025; retained target is 23,252,463. Only rounded agreement is supported.
rows.required_to_close: Exact-precision final 2025 total sheep official table/export.

rows.name: Enterprises, all industries
rows.qualification: At February 2025; economically significant enterprises, provisional. Graph preserves exact count while prose rounds to ten.

rows.name: Sentenced prisoners, all offences and demographic groups
rows.reason: Dated June-2025 fiscal release provides ADE access and metadata, but no independently presented exact 8,199 cell in the acquired publication. Its 11 September 2026 notice discontinues fiscal releases.
rows.required_to_close: Dated official total-sentenced-prisoners fiscal 2024/25 table/export, with counting/rounding semantics. Do not substitute calendar year or quarterly stock.

rows.name: Average weekly household expenditure, total
rows.qualification: Year ended June 2023; average weekly expenditure net of deductions; same 1597.5 published graph cell.

rows.name: Median weekly earnings, all groups
rows.reason: Retained 202606 target is 1,391. Original June-2026 release separately presents 1,419 for median weekly wage/salary earnings. The exact ADE table population/measure/vintage has not been reconciled; no defect or replacement value is asserted.
rows.required_to_close: Exact INC_INC_001 table metadata and original dated 202606 cell resolving earnings population and apparent headline difference.

rows.name: Gender pay gap, all ages

MEASURE_INC_INC_010.label: Gender pay gap based on median hourly earnings (percent)

rows.qualification: June-quarter median hourly wage/salary gap; 5.3 percent at published one-decimal precision, not an adjusted pay-equality measure.

rows.name: Median household income from all sources, all regions and household types

MEASURE_INC_INC_011.label: Median Income from All Sources collected

rows.reason: Official income metadata establishes the household age exclusion and June-quarter weekly snapshot, but acquired publication has no household 2,438 cell. Individual income statistics cannot certify this household estimate.
rows.required_to_close: Exact dated INC_INC_011 household table/export for 202606, total LGR/HHTYPE and MED_INC_ALL_SOUR; confirm household aggregation/basis and revision status.

rows.name: Fatal and serious non-fatal injuries, all groups

SEVERITY_INJ_INJ_001.label: Total fatal and serious non fatal injuries

rows.qualification: Original updated 2000–2024 release CSV: all-population/all-age/all-cause combined serious injuries, 2021. Publication points to INJ_INJ_001. Later nonfatal-only year is not substituted; mortality/revision caveats remain.

rows.name: Ngai Tahu Whanui iwi grouping, Maori descent usually resident population
rows.qualification: 2018 estimated iwi grouping count; shared census/admin/nonresponse-weighting lineage, not an official 2018 Census count or 2023 observation.

rows.name: Adults convicted, all regions and groups
rows.reason: Dated June-2025 fiscal release links ADE but does not independently present exact 50,741 adult convicted count. Fiscal releases discontinued by notice dated 11 September 2026.
rows.required_to_close: Dated fiscal 2024/25 adult convictions exact total, counting scope/rounding; not calendar-year, charges or prosecutions.

rows.name: People with taxable income, all groups
rows.reason: Dated March-2024 annual LEED release states person-level March-year statistics and links ADE; no exact 4,091,334 total people with taxable income cell appears in acquired public release.
rows.required_to_close: Dated March-year 2024 IZ/AZ/XZ/RZ official export and population/tax-source definitions.

rows.name: Median annual earnings, total earnings and all groups
rows.reason: Dated March-2024 annual LEED release links ADE; no independent 57,610 annual median-earnings cell appears. Taxable income population and total earnings must be distinguished.
rows.required_to_close: Dated 2024 total-earnings median exact export with income-source scope and tax-year convention.

rows.name: Median earnings of full-quarter jobs, all ages

MEASURE_LEED_Q1W_001.label: Median earnings of full quarters jobs

rows.reason: Dated June-2025 quarterly LEED release links ADE and Infoshare. It has no independently presented exact 18,100 full-quarter-job median earnings cell. Jobs are not people and full-quarter jobs are not all/new-hire jobs.
rows.required_to_close: Exact 202506 full-quarter jobs MEDIAN_EARN export with gross/tax/coverage and quarter convention.

rows.name: Estimated resident population, New Zealand

AREA_POPES_SUB_001.label: Total New Zealand by regional council

rows.qualification: At 30 June 2025 provisional national estimated resident population, regional council total; 2023 census base.

rows.name: Estimated resident population, all ethnic groups, sexes and ages
rows.qualification: At 30 June 2023 national estimated resident population, all people. Exact all-person total; does not certify the ethnic disaggregation or its broader dataset.

rows.name: Population projection, median scenario, current calendar year
rows.qualification: 2024-base median projection at 30 June 2026; not an observed population count.

rows.name: Labour force projection, median scenario, current calendar year
rows.reason: 2024-base original labour-force projection workbook Table 1 E13 gives median 2026 value 3,144 thousand. Retained 3,144,100 cannot be verified to the extra hundred from this rounded table.
rows.required_to_close: Exact-precision P50, SEX3, total ages 2026 official export; projection not observed workforce or employment.

rows.name: Household projection, Medium A, next published horizon
rows.reason: Original 2018-base household workbook presents B living-arrangement-rate scenarios; target selects MEDIUMA at 2028 with 2,087,100. Medium B 2,029 thousand is a different scenario and is not comparable.
rows.required_to_close: Exact Medium A 2028 household projection export, base and A-assumption definitions. Do not switch to recommended Medium B silently.

rows.name: Labour productivity index, measured sector
rows.qualification: Measured sector, year ended March 2025; 1996=1000 index; provisional.

rows.name: Labour productivity annual change, measured sector
rows.qualification: Measured-sector year ended March 2025 annual percentage change; provisional, not the longer growth-cycle columns.

rows.name: Output annual growth, measured sector
rows.qualification: Measured-sector year ended March 2025 annual percentage change; provisional, not the longer growth-cycle columns.
